control_profile: Exact final-target sign inversion with the baseline downward volatility scaling, drawdown brakes, close-confirmed loss stop, and one-way turnover cap.
falsifier: Reject continuation if exact final-target inversion remains nonpositive gross or net of base costs, or if it fails to improve the baseline across folds and regimes.
formation_horizon: three completed bars measured against a sixty-three-bar causal reference window
hypothesis: Aligned aggressive flow during an abnormal residual price and activity shock is informed at the eight-hour horizon, so the baseline reversal sign should be inverted exactly.
rebalance_horizon: one daily cohort with three equally weighted overlapping cohorts
